policy: Roshni does not rank brands, recommend where to buy, or earn anything from any brand. Profiles describe who makes a product, what it is, and what to check. A well-known brand name does not protect you from fake, B-grade or wrongly matched equipment: the checks matter more than the logo.

panel: Get the exact model number and the datasheet, and check the label on the back matches it (watts, Voc, Isc).
Verify every serial number on the manufacturer's own website or app, never on a link the seller sends.
Ask for A-grade panels from an authorised distributor, in writing. Very cheap 'same brand' panels are often B-grade or copies.

Check the manufacturing date and that the model is current: older large-format stock is sold cheaply as makers move to new standards (China's GB 47834-2026 takes effect 1 Jan 2027), which can make replacements and warranty claims harder.
Get the product warranty (often 12 years) and performance warranty (often 25-30 years) in writing, with the name of the company in Pakistan that will honour it.
Do not mix different panel models or wattages in the same string.
inverter: On-grid inverters switch off during load-shedding. If you need backup, you need a hybrid (or off-grid) inverter.
Check the maximum DC voltage and MPPT range against your string on the coldest morning (Roshni's rules R03-R05 do this).

For a battery: check the inverter's battery voltage class (low-voltage 48 V or high-voltage) and that your battery is on the maker's published approved-battery list, with the right communication protocol (CAN or RS485).
Match single-phase or three-phase to your connection.
Ask who repairs it in Pakistan, where the nearest service centre is, and whether the warranty is honoured locally and in writing.
For net billing, ask the installer to confirm the model and its settings are accepted by your DISCO.
battery_lithium: Compare usable kWh (after depth-of-discharge limits), not just nominal kWh or Ah.
Check the battery is on your inverter maker's approved list, and that the BMS talks to the inverter (CAN or RS485). Some combinations also need a minimum battery firmware.
Check continuous discharge power (kW) covers what must run during load-shedding, including motor and fridge starts.
Ask for the warranty in years AND cycles, the depth of discharge it assumes, and who in Pakistan honours it.
Many brands sell packs assembled from bought-in cells: ask who makes the cells and the BMS, and for the cell datasheet.
LiFePO4 (LFP) chemistry is the common choice for home storage; ask which chemistry the pack uses.
battery_lead_acid: Tubular deep-cycle batteries suit UPS and solar backup better than car-type batteries.
Compare capacity at the stated discharge rate (e.g. C10 or C20) and the warranty period; lead-acid usually lasts far fewer cycles than lithium.
Flooded tubular batteries need distilled-water top-ups and ventilation; sealed (maintenance-free) ones do not need topping up.
Do not mix old and new batteries, or different brands and capacities, in one bank.
Check the inverter's charging settings match lead-acid, and that the battery's date code is recent.
Keep the warranty card and invoice; ask about the dealer's replacement policy.

brands.name: LONGi
brands.about: One of the world's largest monocrystalline silicon and module manufacturers. Panels sold under the Hi-MO name (e.g. Hi-MO 6, Hi-MO 9, Hi-MO X series); model codes start with LR5 or LR7.
brands.technology: Back-contact (BC / HPBC) cells on recent ranges; listed among the highest commercial module efficiencies (about 25% in TaiyangNews' Oct 2026 listing).
brands.pakistan: Widely sold in Pakistan and widely copied. Verify every panel.

verify.label: LONGi module authenticity check (enter the serial number)

brands.name: Jinko Solar
brands.about: Large global module maker. Panels sold as the Tiger Neo series; model codes start with JKM.
brands.technology: N-type TOPCon (Tiger Neo), including bifacial versions; Tiger Neo 5.0 shown at SNEC 2026.
brands.pakistan: Widely sold in Pakistan and widely copied. Each module carries a unique serial number laminated inside it.

verify.label: No public online serial check confirmed; ask Jinko support or the authorised distributor to confirm serial numbers in writing

brands.name: JA Solar
brands.about: Large global module maker. Panels sold as the DeepBlue series; model codes start with JAM.
brands.technology: N-type TOPCon; DeepBlue 5.0 listed at 24.1% efficiency (TaiyangNews, Oct 2026).
brands.pakistan: Widely available in Pakistan.

verify.label: JA Solar product verification page (serial number / product code)

brands.name: Canadian Solar
brands.origin: Founded in Canada; manufacturing mainly in Asia
brands.about: Listed international manufacturer of panels and storage. Model codes start with CS (e.g. CS6W, CS7N); HiKu / TOPHiKu series.
brands.technology: TOPCon on current ranges; third-generation TOPCon up to about 670 W.
brands.pakistan: Sold in Pakistan. No public online serial check was found on Canadian Solar's own site; ask the distributor for written serial confirmation.

verify.label: No public online serial check found; ask the authorised distributor to confirm serial numbers in writing

brands.name: Trina Solar
brands.about: Large global module maker for homes, businesses and utilities. Panels sold as the Vertex series; model codes start with TSM.
brands.technology: N-type TOPCon (Vertex N, i-TOPCon); showed TOPCon 3.0 and a hybrid BC module at SNEC 2026.
brands.pakistan: Sold in Pakistan.

verify.label: Trina customer service module query (serial number)

brands.name: AIKO
brands.about: Cell and module maker focused on back-contact technology.
brands.technology: ABC (all back contact) cells; listed joint-first in commercial module efficiency (about 25%, TaiyangNews Oct 2026).
brands.pakistan: Less common than the brands above; check distributor and warranty support carefully.

verify.label: No public serial check found; ask the distributor

brands.name: Astronergy
brands.about: Module maker owned by the Chint Group; ranges include ASTRO N.
brands.technology: N-type TOPCon.
brands.pakistan: Sold in Pakistan through distributors.

brands.name: Risen Energy
brands.about: Listed Chinese module maker (Shenzhen ChiNext).
brands.technology: Heterojunction (HJT, Hyper-ion series) as its main line, plus TOPCon modules.
brands.pakistan: Sold in Pakistan through distributors.

verify.label: No public serial check found; ask the distributor

brands.name: Crown (Crown Solar Energy / Crown Micro)
brands.about: Sells panels, inverters and lithium batteries in Pakistan through authorised distributors. Directories list Crown Micro Global and Crown Solar Energy as separate entries.
brands.technology: Varies by product; ask for each product's datasheet and who manufactures it.
brands.pakistan: Local brand with a dealer network.

brands.name: Inverex
brands.about: Karachi-based solar brand selling inverters (e.g. Nitrox hybrid series), panels and lithium batteries.
brands.technology: Hybrid and on-grid inverters; lithium battery packs. Ask who manufactures each product and for the datasheet.
brands.pakistan: Large local dealer network. Ask for the nearest authorised service centre and written warranty terms.

verify.label: Ask the authorised dealer for the warranty card and serial registration

brands.name: Solis (Ginlong)
brands.about: Inverter brand of Ginlong Technologies; on-grid (S5/S6-GR) and hybrid (S6-EH) ranges.
brands.technology: String on-grid and hybrid inverters; check the hybrid model's battery voltage class and approved batteries.
brands.pakistan: Sold in Pakistan through distributors.

brands.name: Growatt
brands.about: Residential and commercial inverters, plus batteries. Off-grid SPF series, hybrid SPH series, on-grid MIN/MOD series.
brands.technology: Off-grid, hybrid and on-grid inverters; own battery ranges.
brands.pakistan: Widely available in Pakistan.

brands.name: Huawei (FusionSolar)
brands.about: SUN2000 inverters and LUNA2000 batteries with the FusionSolar monitoring app.
brands.technology: Residential storage pairs SUN2000 hybrid inverters with LUNA2000 batteries in one ecosystem; check which batteries are supported if you plan a different brand.
brands.pakistan: Sold in Pakistan, often in larger and commercial systems.

brands.name: Sungrow
brands.about: One of the world's largest inverter suppliers; residential SH hybrid series (about 3-25 kW) and SG on-grid series.
brands.technology: On-grid, hybrid and utility inverters; storage systems.
brands.pakistan: Present in Pakistan, particularly in larger installations.

brands.name: Deye
brands.about: Known for hybrid inverters; SUN series single-phase (about 3-12 kW) and three-phase (about 6-30 kW). Model codes like SUN-6K-SG04LP1.
brands.technology: Low-voltage (48 V) and high-voltage hybrid ranges. Deye publishes an approved-battery list (latest seen: DY-LV48-0132, 19 Oct 2026) naming batteries such as Pylontech and Dyness, with the protocol (CAN or RS485) and the setup number to choose on the inverter.
brands.pakistan: Widely used in Pakistani hybrid systems.

brands.name: Knox
brands.about: Brand of Electro Industries, founded March 2020; first product the KNOX 5G on-grid inverter (Feb 2021). Krypton and Zynex inverter lines; also sells lithium batteries.
brands.technology: On-grid and hybrid inverters, lithium batteries. Ask who manufactures each product and for the datasheet.
brands.pakistan: Company lists Knox Care Centres in Faisalabad, Islamabad and Lahore. Warranty claims about 10 years come from resellers; get the terms in writing.

brands.name: GoodWe
brands.about: Listed inverter maker with hybrid and on-grid ranges, single- and three-phase, plus batteries.
brands.technology: Hybrid inverters with LFP battery support; check the approved-battery list for your model.
brands.pakistan: Sold in Pakistan through distributors.

brands.name: Fox ESS
brands.origin: China (production base in Wenzhou; European HQ in Germany)
brands.about: Solar inverter and residential energy storage company.
brands.technology: Hybrid inverters and residential batteries.
brands.pakistan: Less common in Pakistan; check local service support.

brands.name: Fronus
brands.about: Solar inverter brand sold across Punjab and Sindh, described by retailers as a local brand.
brands.technology: Hybrid inverters; ask who manufactures each product and for the datasheet.
brands.pakistan: Ask for the service network and written warranty.

brands.name: ITEL Energy
brands.about: Sells lithium batteries (e.g. 12 V 100 Ah) and hybrid inverters in Pakistan.
brands.technology: Ask who makes the cells and the BMS, and for datasheets.
brands.pakistan: Growing retail presence.

brands.name: Ziewnic
brands.about: Sells inverters (e.g. Z5 PV series) and residential lithium batteries.
brands.technology: Ask who manufactures each product and for the datasheet.
brands.pakistan: Local brand; ask for the service network and written warranty.

brands.name: Pylontech
brands.about: Lithium iron phosphate (LFP) battery maker; modular rack batteries for homes (US2000/US3000/US5000, Force L low-voltage; Force H high-voltage).
brands.technology: LFP, stackable 48 V modules with CAN/RS485 communication. Pylontech publishes an inverter compatibility list; some inverters need a minimum battery firmware (e.g. for Deye).
brands.pakistan: Widely used in Pakistani hybrid systems.

verify.label: Check your inverter's approved-battery list (e.g. Deye's) and Pylontech's compatibility list

brands.name: Dyness
brands.about: Residential and commercial LFP storage; stackable low-voltage batteries.
brands.technology: LFP, 48 V stackable modules; appears on Deye's approved battery list. Dyness publishes its own compatible-inverter list.
brands.pakistan: Sold in Pakistan; reviewers note a thinner service network than larger brands, so confirm local support.

brands.name: BYD
brands.about: Major global battery and vehicle maker; Battery-Box residential storage.
brands.technology: Cobalt-free LFP, modular; more common in high-voltage hybrid systems. Check your inverter supports BYD's high-voltage range.
brands.pakistan: Less common in typical 48 V Pakistani home systems; check inverter compatibility first.

brands.name: Narada
brands.about: Long-established industrial battery maker (telecom, data centres, energy storage), with low-voltage lithium products.
brands.technology: Lead-acid and lithium industrial batteries; check the specific home-storage model and inverter compatibility.
brands.pakistan: Present mainly in telecom and industrial supply.

brands.name: Felicity Solar
brands.about: Sells wall-mounted and rack-mounted lithium batteries and inverters.
brands.technology: LFP batteries; Felicity publishes compatibility lists for its battery models (e.g. FLA48171).
brands.pakistan: Sold in Pakistan through distributors; confirm local warranty support.

brands.name: Sunwoda
brands.about: Large battery maker; its energy-storage arm makes mostly commercial and utility-scale systems.
brands.technology: LFP cells and storage systems.
brands.pakistan: Rare as a consumer brand; may appear as the cell maker inside other brands' packs.

brands.name: Hithium
brands.about: Energy-storage cell and system maker, mainly utility-scale (e.g. 314 Ah LFP cells, 5 MWh containers).
brands.technology: Large-format LFP cells.
brands.pakistan: Mainly industrial; may appear as the cell maker inside other brands' packs.

brands.name: Sacred Sun (Shuangdeng)
brands.about: Industrial battery maker (telecom, data centres, storage), lead-acid and lithium.
brands.technology: Industrial lead-acid and LFP systems.
brands.pakistan: Mainly industrial and telecom supply. Limited public information on home products.

brands.name: Leoch
brands.about: Battery maker with lead-acid and lithium ranges for UPS, telecom and storage.
brands.technology: Lead-acid (AGM/gel) and lithium; check the exact model's datasheet.
brands.pakistan: Limited public information on Pakistani distribution.

brands.name: Soluna
brands.about: Lithium battery brand seen in some markets. Roshni could not confirm its manufacturer or origin from public sources.
brands.technology: Ask for the cell maker, BMS maker and full datasheet.
brands.pakistan: Limited public information. Be extra careful with warranty and inverter compatibility.

brands.name: AGS (Atlas Battery)
brands.about: Made by Atlas Battery Limited, founded 1966; automotive, motorcycle, UPS and tubular batteries.
brands.technology: Lead-acid, including tubular deep-cycle batteries for UPS and solar backup.
brands.pakistan: Major market player with wide dealer network.

brands.name: Exide Pakistan
brands.about: Automotive, motorcycle, industrial and solar lead-acid batteries; began domestic car-battery production in 1953.
brands.technology: Lead-acid, including tubular and UPS ranges.
brands.pakistan: Long-established local manufacturer.

brands.name: Osaka
brands.about: Popular in UPS, tubular and automotive batteries. Roshni could not confirm the parent company from public sources.
brands.technology: Lead-acid, including tubular deep-cycle.
brands.pakistan: Widely sold.

brands.name: Volta
brands.about: Established lead-acid battery name; market reports list Volta & Osaka Batteries among competitors.
brands.technology: Lead-acid automotive and UPS batteries.
brands.pakistan: Widely sold.

brands.name: Phoenix Battery
brands.origin: Pakistan (Century Engineering Industries, per market reports)
brands.about: Automotive, deep-cycle, UPS and solar batteries, including the TX tubular range.
brands.technology: Lead-acid tubular and UPS batteries.
brands.pakistan: Widely sold.

brands.name: Daewoo Battery
brands.origin: Pakistan (Faisalabad; a brand of Treet Battery)
brands.about: Made locally in Faisalabad using Korean technology, per the company; sealed / maintenance-free and other lead-acid batteries.
brands.technology: Lead-acid, including maintenance-free.
brands.pakistan: Local manufacturer.
